title: OpenAI signs $38B multi-year AWS cloud deal

sources.quote: Under this new $38 billion agreement, which will have continued growth over the next seven years, OpenAI is accessing AWS compute comprising hundreds of thousands of state-of-the-art NVIDIA GPUs, with the ability to expand to tens of millions of CPUs to rapidly scale agentic workloads.

explain: OpenAI's first big contract with Amazon: $38 billion of AWS cloud computing, mainly Nvidia GPUs, over about seven years. It came days after OpenAI's new Microsoft deal ended Microsoft's first claim on OpenAI's computing needs.
